title: 皐月賞の後に・吹きすさむは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O wrings out the fruits of her training for her duel with Yaeno Muteki, emerging victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both of them put their hearts into the race, and Sakura Chiyono O is as elated over her victory as Yaeno Muteki is devastated over her loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is struck by just how strongly their rivalry affects them both.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan watches from the stands, she burns with eagerness, ready to give it her all in one of the few races she'll ever get to run—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Japanese Derby—the most important race of all in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes.
